Na seriji MR presjeka lijevog koljena nalaze se umjerene do teže OA promjene koljenskog zgloba,
izraženije u medijalnom kompartmentu femorotibijalnog zgloba.
Blage degenerativne promjene stražnjeg križnog ligamenta, bez znakova rupture.
Uznapredovale degenerativne promjene prednjeg križnog ligamenta, bez znakova rupture.
Entezopatske promjene i blaži entezitis patelarnog hvatišta patelarnog ligamenta. Entezopatske
promjene tetive m. kvadricepsa.
Kompleksna ruptura stražnjeg roga medijalnog meniska koji je u cijelosti stanjen, degenerativno
promijenjen. Ramp lezija posteromedijalno. Blaža ekstruzija trupa meniska pod MCL.
Blaže degenerativne promjene lateralnog meniska, izraženije bijele zone, bez evidentne rupture.
Kolateralni ligamenti su održani.
Blaga tendinopatija tetive m. popliteus.
Denudacija hrskavica medijalnog platoa tibije i medijalnog kondila femura.
Hondromalacija I-II. stupnja lateralnog kompartmenta FT zgloba te patelarne i trohlearne
hrskavice.
Manji izljev u koljenskom zglobu, bez značajne hipertrofije sinovije.
Bakerova cista veličine 42x18 mm.
Ostale prikazane koštane, mekotkivne i neurovaskularne strukture uredne su morfologije i
intenziteta signala.

Trouvailles :

Il y a un petit épanchement intra-articulaire sans kyste poplité.

Il y a changements dégénératifs impliquant les trois compartiments. Plus précisément, il y a un amincissement modéré du cartilage au niveau de la rotule et à la partie centrale de la trochlée du fémur. Il y a un léger amincissement et fibrillation superficielle du cartilage du compartiment interne et externe. Il n’y a pas de région de perte de cartilage complet.

Il y a changements dégénératifs intra-substance impliquant le corps et la corne postérieure du ménisque interne sans déchirure. Le ménisque externe est sans particularité.

Autrement, le ligament croisé antérieur, le ligament croisé postérieur, le mécanisme des extenseurs, le ligament collatéral interne, le semi-membraneux, le muscle et tendon du poplité, le biceps fémoris distal, le ligament collatéral externe et la bandelette ilio-tibiale sont sans particularité.

Conclusion :

1. Légers changements dégénératifs impliquant les trois compartiments du genou sans région de perte de cartilage complet.

2. Changements dégénératifs intra-substance du ménisque interne sans déchirure linéaire bien définie.

3. Petit épanchement intra-articulaire sans kyste poplité.

Diz eklemindeki trikompartmantal dejeneratif eklem hastalığı medyal femorotibyal ve patellofemoral eklem yüzeylerinde belirgin olup medyal femoral kondilin ağırlık taşıyan yüzeyindeki geniş tam kat kondral kayıp, tibyal plato medyalindeki %50'yi aşan segmenter kondral incelme, patella apeksindeki kondral fissür ve troklear kıkırdak medyali ve orta kesimindeki %50'ye ulaşan geniş kondral incelmeler, subkortikal medüller fibrovasküler değişiklikler ve hipertrofik marjinal osteofitler ile karakterize. Lateral menisküsteki dejenerasyona gövdesi düzeyindeki serbest kenar küntleşmesi eşlik ediyor (milimetrik radyal yırtık açısından şüpheli). Medyal menisküs gövdesi düzeyinde horizontal longitudinal yırtık izleniyor. Medyal menisküs medyale 4,5 ekstrüde. Ekstrüde menisküs iç yan bağı basılıyor ve iç yan bağın çevresi ödemli. Medyal ve lateral gastroknemius kaslarnın origoları çevresindeki gangliyon kistlerinin büyüğü 1,4 cm toplam boyuta ulaşıyor. Ön çapraz > arka çapraz bağlarda mukoid dejenerasyon gözleniyor. Proksimal tibyofibular eklem normal.

Findings:  Tiny joint effusion and popliteal cyst. No intra-articular loose bodies. No sinister bone marrow changes.  Intact cruciate and collateral ligaments.  Intact lateral meniscus.  Mucoid degeneration of the posterior horn and body of the medial meniscus which appears attenuated and partially extruded. There is a small horizontal tear of the body which breaches the inferior meniscal surface.  Normal appearance of the pes anserine tendons, popliteus tendon, distal biceps femoris tendon and distal iliotibial band.  
Intact quadriceps and patellar tendons. Slight lateralization of the patellar relative to the trochlear groove. Trochlear dysplasia with a shallow trochlear groove noted. Normal T T - T G and patellar tendon ratio.  Focal high grade chondral thinning along the posterior aspect of the weightbearing portion of the medial femoral condyle and lateral retropatellar facet. Relatively well-maintained lateral tibiofemoral hyaline articular cartilage.

Stable looking undersurface horizontal tear at the posterior horn of the medial meniscus, with no accompanying medial meniscal extrusion of note, nor is there any involvement of the corresponding posterior root and ligament.

An undisplaced degenerative tear of the free edge of the body and anterior horn of the lateral meniscus is again seen, together with lateral meniscal body extrusion.

Focal full-thickness articular cartilage loss noted at the junction between the central and posterior thirds of the lateral femoral condyle, with no accompanying fracture lines or mass lesions, nor any articular surface collapse.

Generalized thinning of medial and lateral weightbearing articular cartilage damage, with focal grade 3/4 articular cartilage loss being centred on the median ridge of the patella.

Moderate suprapatellar effusion, there are no intra-articular bodies.
A high-riding patella is also noted, together with patellofemoral incongruity and subtle superolateral Hoffa's fat pad impingement - the patellar lateralization present is not deemed secondary to the underlying effusion.

Small, non ruptured Baker's cyst noted posteromedially.

Intact cruciate and collateral ligaments, extensor tendons, distal iliotibial band and popliteus musculotendinous unit.

No other skeletal abnormality of note.
Grossly unremarkable remaining imaged extra-articular soft tissues.

Impression:
Medial and lateral meniscal pathology, age commensurate tricompartmental articular degenerative changes, multifactorial extensor mechanism abnormalities.

INDICATION:    [Age] female for right knee pain that is functional impairment. Mild OA on x-ray, but pain persistent/worsening.   .

.
TECHNICAL INFORMATION AND PROTOCOL:

Proton density and T2 weighted sagittal, coronal and axial imaging was performed through the knee including a 3D Fat suppressed proton density weighted sequence. No contrast was administered.

FINDINGS:

The 3-D proton density sequence was reformatted and manipulated to aid in the interpretation of this examination.

The extensor mechanism are intact. The patellar cartilage is intact. The trochlear cartilage is intact. The patellar soft tissues normal.

The TT-TG interval measures 5 mm, within normal limits.

The anterior cruciate, posterior cruciate, medial collateral and lateral collateral ligament is complex, including the fibular lateral collateral ligament, iliotibial band, biceps femoris and popliteus tendons, are intact. No significant anterior tibial translation. Mucoid degeneration of the anterior cruciate ligament.

Medial meniscus is intact.  Articular cartilage of the medial femoral condyle is uniformly reduced in thickness.

Lateral meniscus anterior horn complex radial tear, posterior horn radial tear. Articular cartilage lateral of the femoral condyle is uniformly reduced in thickness.

Small suprapatellar knee joint effusion. 1.5 x 1.5 x 3.9 cm Baker's cyst.

Marrow signal is normal. Soft tissues is normal. Bone-on-bone articulation in the lateral compartment.

INTERPRETATION: 
Lateral meniscus anterior and posterior horn radial tears. Notably, the anterior horn demonstrates a complex radial tear while the posterior horn demonstrates a simple radial tear.

Uniform thinning of the bilateral femoral condyle articular cartilage, likely age-related etiology.

Baker's cyst. Bone-on-bone articulation in the lateral compartment.
